title: Video factory
summary: Four agents make a short film on a CPU: a director plans, a Blender artist renders a scene headless, a Hyperframes compositor exports the film, and a viewer judges it.

showcase.caption: A 6-second film this factory's own agents made from the starter brief, on the test models: a Blender still of a wireframe icosphere with a slow push-in and a title. The object itself does not move.
